text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The table in the cited passage lists Development of $450,000, $500,000, $400,000 and $350,000 for Q1-Q4 2027 respectively."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Total row shows $1,700,000 in the Development column for the same table."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Budget Notes section states the figures reflect the originally approved budget and that the Finance Committee's December 2026 revision adjusted the total project budget to $2,600,000."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Pure absence claim asserting only that the documents don't state the development-specific allocation of the revision; no other facts asserted."},{"claim_index":4,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Pure absence claim that no revised development-only budget is stated; asserts nothing else about the project."}]}
